Verbatim copies, committed for WI-WFC-BETA1-BP5-ARCHIVE-PORT-001's equivalence
test (tests/unit/test_archive_equivalence.py), of files staged read-only at
build/wfc/bp5-evidence-inputs/ (ignored by .gitignore, not available in a
fresh checkout). real_run/ reconstructs the archived Run's own state-root and
OPS directory layout from the already-archived copy under
archive/unclassified/wfc-beta1-bp3-remediation-review-001-20261119-01/{run,ops}/
(its manifest.json records the original absolute locations under
/home/stefan/wfc-state and /home/stefan/wfc-ops, not reachable from every
sandbox; the equivalence test relocates a disposable working copy and edits
only the path-metadata fields that encode that relocation -- never a run
fact). legacy/ is the frozen historical baseline the equivalence test runs
unmodified, for comparison against the installed module.

No source record was changed; every hash below matches both
build/wfc/bp5-evidence-inputs/PROVENANCE.txt and the archived manifest.json's
own copied_files digests.
